parsed.g: Preview the Magento Blank theme for the shop via the Magento Admin panel
P_t: Identified the Content menu in the Magento Admin navigation bar
Opened the Content menu to reveal Design submenu options including Configuration, Themes, and Schedule
R_t: Navigate to Content > Design > Themes (or Configuration) page successfully
Locate the Magento Blank theme in the theme list
Click the Preview button/link for the Magento Blank theme
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM at step 3 shows the Magento Admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login), not the Design Configuration page. The page contains a login form with username and password fields and a 'Sign in' button. The agent has been logged out or the session has expired. The page title is 'Magento Admin' and the URL context is the admin login page at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/admin/auth/login.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access any admin pages
The agent must not apply or save any theme changes — only preview the Magento Blank theme

F_t.cause: The click did not navigate to the Design Configuration page. The ground-truth DOM at step 3 shows the admin login page, indicating the session expired or the navigation failed and the user was redirected to the login screen.

F_t.action: Attempted scroll down at step 3 to find theme list
F_t.cause: The agent believed it was on the Design Configuration page, but the ground-truth DOM shows the login page. There is no theme list to scroll to; the agent is not authenticated.
